scope: Align current implementation QA request/schema with existing one-to-one finding completeness; preserve genuine failed trial and agent patch.
riskAnalysis: Narrow output count/IDs without forcing positive reviews. No permission, budget, source patch execution or publication change. Missing prior finding fails before provider dispatch; original failure remains immutable.

threatModel.assets: Reviewer completeness, source/evidence integrity, historical decisions and execution/publication boundaries.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Validated Specialist receipt supplies data IDs only; owner/server remains authoritative for all permissions.
threatModel.abuseCases: Extra or forged decisions, omitted findings, schema bypass, fabricated acceptance, secret-bearing diagnostics, missing prior receipts.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact count and finding enum plus unchanged semantic uniqueness/evidence checks; closed sanitized categories only; no authority expansion.

rollback: Revert new QA schema/instructions/diagnostic metadata on feature branch; keep original trial, generated patch, reservations and all audit records.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Strict schema and existing provider parser remain; new extra count/forged ID outputs denied.
negativePaths.stale-state: Fresh prior receipt and exact source/task binding remain authoritative.
negativePaths.concurrency: No CAS/serial-authority change; existing mandatory coverage retained.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing cancellation/revocation/cleanup behavior unchanged and native failure tests passed.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker modification; original destruction evidence and interruption tests retained.
negativePaths.api-outage: No provider retries introduced; existing failure handling unchanged.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: No owner/role/tool grants added; exact source pin changes require fresh reviewed enrollment.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No budget, reservation or token-limit changes; remaining1.80USD conservatively enforced.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Original third-stage failure preserves first two results, QA usage and destroyed workspace; no downstream success claimed.

defects.rootCause: Current Specialist is restricted to one finding while QA schema permits up to three decisions and lacks explicit one-to-one instructions.
defects.detectionGap: Deterministic fixtures always mapped exactly one decision, so successful schema generation was not checked against this semantic guard.
defects.regression: Schema-valid old overcount reproduction; new count/enum, missing-prior, criticism freedom, generic guard diagnostics and historical compatibility checks.
defects.historicalPrevention: Derive request cardinality from validated prior evidence and retain independent backend validation.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing implementation/schema/parser/failure boundary only; no new execution path or organization.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new packages, services, credentials or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Output overcount, forged IDs, missing prior evidence, suppressed criticism and secret-bearing diagnostics.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing or unsupported prior evidence denies request; invalid count/IDs fail schema and semantic guards. Failed paid work remains revoked with observed usage retained.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Old permissive schema counterexample, extra decisions, invented ID, absent prior receipt, duplicate generic finding, malformed diagnostics and historical request fixtures.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor approved actual changes; one invalid new test enum was corrected without altering production decisions.
proactiveReview.recovery: Original failure and agent patch remain immutable; no paid retry until exact new release/configuration/admission qualification.
proactiveReview.readiness: 94 existing/focused cases passed before one new fixture typo; corrected new5/5, QA historical14/14 and Auditor5/5 passed. Full hosted qualification pending.
